content: .{@-होत्रम्@} [अग्नये हूयतेऽत्र, हु-त्र, च. त.] .²1 an oblation to Agni (chiefly of milk, oil and sour gruel.). .²2 maintenance of the sacred fire and offering oblation to it; (अग्नये होत्रं होमोऽस्मिन् कर्मणीति अग्निहोत्रमिति कर्मनाम); or the sacred fire itself; तपोवनाग्निहोत्रधूमलेखासु <ls>K. 26</ls>. होता स्यात् ˚त्रस्य <ls>Ms. 11. 36</ls>. ({@-त्र@}) {%a.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 destined for, connected with, Agnihotra. .²2 sacrificing to Agni.
